description: Luw.ai Landscape AI: design a garden, yard or outdoor area inside a masked region of a photo, with plants chosen for the location's climate and sun exposure. Costs 1 credit.

enhance_prompt.description: Let Luw.ai's prompt enhancer expand a short prompt.

image.description: Photo of the outdoor area (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

mask_image.description: Black/white mask, white = area to landscape (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

prompt.description: What you want, in plain language.

sun_exposure.description: e.g. "Full sun (6+ hours)", "Partial sun (4 - 6 hours)", "Shade (less than 4 hours)".
